roles: Preserve the acquired primary family for display, body, navigation, controls and wordmark text.
Display: approximately 88–106px expanded and 40–64px compact, weight 600–700, leading 1.02–1.04 and tracking near -0.06em. Preserve intentional line breaks.
Editorial headings: approximately 56–100px expanded and 44–70px compact according to existing composition.
Body: 16–18px with 1.5–1.7 leading. Controls: 14–16px; form entry at least 16px.
Use the upright variable file at default width without synthesized italics.
Build must await document.fonts.ready, inspect matching loaded FontFace entries and check required weights.
Preserve the acquired secondary family for concise labels, indices and metadata.
Use approximately 11–12px, 1.4–1.6 leading and modest positive tracking.
Keep prose and display headlines in Instrument Sans; verify actual local font loading in Build.

interfaceDirection: Preserve the 4px spacing base with 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 48, 64, 96 and 128px intervals. Keep content width near 1440px, expanded gutters of 48–64px, compact gutters of 20–24px and prose widths of 45–65 characters. Retain approximately 96–128px expanded and 64–80px compact vertical spacing, adjusted for content. Preserve the dark canvas and established ivory interludes. Use raised surfaces for functional grouping, not ordinary prose. Retain open editorial rows, broad native media frames, overlapping project captions and distinct disclosure surfaces. Controls use 2–4px radii, media 6–8px and grouped panels 10–12px. Use 24–32px panel padding, reducing to 18–24px where needed. Keep existing functional rules without ornamental grids or ambient shadows. Ivory serves primary actions, focus, selected states and recurring media or panel surfaces; use charcoal equivalents on ivory. Essential light control boundaries use #6B6961, which exceeds 3:1 against every light surface. Decorative dividers may remain quieter. Preserve hover, focus, pressed, selected, expanded, disabled, pending and error states. Targets remain at least 44 by 44px, with state cues beyond color. Retain existing arrows and plus/minus cues. Native views grow or reflow rather than crop their content.

motionDirection.summary: Preserve the native motion system for hierarchy, explanation and feedback within existing geometry. Later implementation changes require fresh browser evidence.
principles: For spatial continuity on initial load, introduce headline groups, supporting copy, actions and software media with 14–20px vertical translation over 550–800ms, decisive ease-out cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), 60–90ms offsets and at most 240ms staggering; after paint use transform only without hiding content late; reduced motion and restored middle-position loads show final states immediately.

For explanation when individual work views approach entry, introduce the native frame with opacity and up to 20px vertical translation over 600–750ms, followed by its caption after 60–80ms, using smooth ease-out; keep the scroller ancestor untransformed; reduced motion shows both immediately.

For explanation when the studio statement and supporting view approach entry, slide the statement horizontally approximately 10px with opacity over 450–600ms and introduce the supporting group with opacity after 60–100ms, using restrained ease-out; reduced motion presents final states.

For process progression on first approach, emphasize indices and titles from accessible muted text to primary text over 450–550ms with gentle ease-out and 60–80ms staggering capped at 240ms; descriptions stay readable, completed emphasis remains permanent and reduced motion uses final emphasis immediately.

For intent feedback on hover-capable fine pointers and keyboard focus, update control colors and borders over 120–200ms with crisp ease-out and arrow translation no greater than 3px; retain visible focus; reduced motion removes translation and makes state feedback immediate.

For disclosure explanation on pointer or keyboard activation, update the indicator and answer opacity over 160–220ms with controlled ease-out while native flow handles expansion without animated height; reduced motion updates immediately and information never depends on hover.

For local demonstration changes on activation, update filters and workflow configuration immediately with optional opacity feedback under 200ms, and move project navigation over approximately 220ms with short ease-out; reduced motion jumps directly without auto-advance or external requests.

For scroll stability during entry, rapid scrolling, resize, restored positions and rerenders, prepare only leaf groups below the viewport, observe once at threshold 0 with positive bottom rootMargin near 80–96px, unobserve immediately and retain final states after their assigned 450–800ms ease-out; CSS defaults visible, skipped groups finish immediately, and reduced-motion changes or cleanup cancel only owned animations and restore visibility.
avoid: transition: all.
Scale-from-zero entrances, bouncing, perpetual floating and scroll hijacking.
Global opacity-zero classes or hiding already-visible content.
Resetting reveals on exit, reverse scrolling, resize or rerender.
Nested reveal transforms or transformed fixed-control ancestors.
Large blur, filter or clip-path animations.
Invisible backlogs or interaction gated by animation.
Canceling unrelated document animations.
Inferring motion verification from still screenshots.

voice.summary: Personal, capable and direct. Preserve the tagline and lowercase display statements. Use normal capitalization for prose and controls, concrete verbs and practical software descriptions. Keep concept identification concise and visible. Distinguish representative demonstrations from delivered work and describe inquiry availability truthfully.
avoid: Invented expertise, affiliations, endorsements, testimonials or results.
Large-team implications and guaranteed prices or delivery dates.
Generic agency slogans replacing useful information.
Excessive jargon or visitor-facing implementation notes.
False sending success or live-integration claims.
Treating Concept study identification as removable placeholder copy.
